events.verdict: Replay review of the play confirmed Toscano-Anderson (GSW) makes contact with the ball after the ball hits the backboard.
Holmes (SAC) legally contests Oubre Jr.'s (GSW) shot attempt.
Green (GSW) makes contact with Holmes' (SAC) body during his shot attempt.
Toscano-Anderson (GSW) establishes himself in a legal picking position in Hield's (SAC) path and does not deliver any contact.
Holmes (SAC) maintains a legal defensive position and absorbs the contact as he defends Curry (GSW) on the dribble.

Harkless (SAC) collapses his forearm against his body and legally contest Curry's (GSW) driving shot attempt. As both players return to the floor, Harkless makes incidental foot to foot contact with Curry.
Wiggins (GSW) legally contest Barnes' (SAC) shot attempt.
As Holmes (SAC) releases to secure the rebound, he makes marginal contact with Green's (GSW) backside.
Curry (GSW) makes marginal contact with Holmes' (SAC) arm after the release that does not affect his play at the basket.
Curry (GSW) does not maintain a legal pivot foot prior to the release of his dribble.
Green (GSW) makes clean contact with the ball.
Barnes (SAC) establishes himself in a legal picking position in Toscano-Anderson's (GSW) path and does not deliver any contact.
Wiggins (GSW) swipes and misses and does not make contact with Haliburton's (SAC) arm during his driving shot attempt.

Holmes (SAC) reaches in and marginal contact occurs with Gurry's (GSW) head as he makes the pass.  Contact to an opponent?s head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Hield (SAC) naturally loses possession of the ball and is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to GSW.
Wright (SAC) commits a take foul on Curry (GSW).
Harkless (SAC) commits a take foul on Curry (GSW).
Wiggins (GSW) legally contests Barnes' (SAC) jump shot attempt.
Hield (SAC) makes contact with Curry's (GSW) arm after Curry secures the rebound.
